jira.label: Jira / Atlassian
jira.product_group_note: Product-access groups on buffett-dev. remove_product_access deletes the account from every entry in product_groups (same manage:jira-configuration token; no Confluence REST scopes). product_group / product_group_id stay the Jira Software group for older callers. Seed leavers (Erin/Ned/Tyrion) were invited into jira-users-buffett-dev and also landed in confluence-users-buffett-dev. jira-servicemanagement-users-buffett-dev (JSM) is still not in this list. deactivate_user remains a best-effort second attempt that needs org-admin API access, which this personal/non-domain-claimed site likely does not have.
